name: medallion

pattern.for: a part of a product that is a medallion data pipeline: its sources, its bronze, silver and gold layers, its rules and the batch flow that runs them

summary: Design a medallion data pipeline for a part of a product, source systems to bronze, silver and gold, checkpoint by checkpoint (D1-D9), and the batch flow that runs it, checked by the medallion rules at every capture.

changelog.note: The build plan tests (medallion@3): a test of one of eight kinds says what it tests, what it runs on and what must come out; what nothing tests is open until the build plan closes; the design interview drafts the tests and the lineage page shows them.
The pipeline page joins the studio: Where the data comes from.
capture-form's three choices named in words; no quoting the engine.
Every conversation in plain language: no codes, ids or engine output, technical details only when asked (engine 0.11.22).
design-pipeline captures through OTO's capture-form with its menu, and names the product pack, not a studio.
medallion declares itself a pattern of software-architecture (design-pipeline). Needs OTO 0.11.17.
design-pipeline: the lineage view is on the project's home page (engine 0.11.14 installs every declared pack's views and serves them side by side). Needs OTO 0.11.14.
A medallion data pipeline, checkpoint by checkpoint (D1 to D9): the medallion ontology release 2 from Cynergis/medallion-ontology, the design-pipeline skill and the lineage view. Needs OTO 0.11.8.

_about: The pack's identity: its release rises on every published change; `ontology` names the ontology embedded under ontology/ and where it came from; `domain` is the category it belongs to.
